atAGlance: Gỏi xoài is green mango salad, usually with herbs, peanuts, dried shrimp or seafood, and chili-fish sauce dressing.
whatItIs: Gỏi xoài is green mango salad, usually tossed with herbs, peanuts, dried shrimp or beef jerky depending on the shop, and fish-sauce-lime dressing. It is crisp, tart, sweet, salty, and lively.
howToEnjoy: Toss before eating so the dressing reaches the mango, then taste before adding chili. Ask about dried shrimp or beef jerky if you avoid either.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi xoài as a snack or shared salad. Say ít cay, không đậu phộng, or no dried shrimp before it is tossed.
worthKnowing: Green mango in Vietnam is firm and sour, which is why the dressing can be sweet, salty, spicy, and still feel refreshing.
goodToKnow: Ask about dried shrimp, dried beef, peanuts, and chili before it is tossed; those small toppings change the whole salad.
